digest.component_or_area: MCP client authentication and credential provisioning
propositions: Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time into a gitignored .env file as MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* env vars (never committed or rsync'd), mirroring the opcert-guard.map.conf pattern.
The static verifier's tokens file (mcp-static-tokens.json) references materialized PATs via token_env (env var names), never plaintext tokens or raw PAT values inside the file.

Credential rotation requires explicit operator action: re-materialize the PATs from SSM and restart/replace the rebar-mcp process so the verifier reinitializes; autodeploy does not trigger on value-only changes.
A repo-root committed template (mcp-clients.local.example.json) documents the local config shape, rendering to a real gitignored file (mcp-clients.local.json) that never contains secrets.
Both mcp-static-tokens.json and mcp-clients.local.json must be added to .gitignore and rsync RSYNC_EXCLUDES so materialized artifacts are protected from source sync clobbering and never committed.
When all per-client PAT slots are blank, the tokens file is created as {"tokens": []} and the verifier fails-closed at startup, the intended state until an operator populates at least one PAT.
